title: Inspect and Lubricate Tipper Z-Axis Linear Bearings (Grease Wetness on Z-Axis Linear Rails)
summary: Preventive maintenance for an OptiSweep tipper: visually inspect the Z-axis linear rails for grease wetness or dried grease. If the rails are dry, lubricate the bearing blocks through the grease nipples using automotive bearing grease, applying 1.0 to 3.0 cc per bearing block. Do not rely on wiping grease on the rails as a substitute for lubrication.
when_to_use: Use during tipper preventive maintenance to check Z-axis linear rail lubrication condition (wet grease vs dried grease) and to apply grease to the Z-axis bearing blocks when the rails are dry.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the visual inspection of both Z-axis linear rails and, if dry, lubricate the bearing blocks via the grease nipples with automotive bearing grease using the specified quantity per block.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to both Z-axis linear rails and the bearing blocks
Grease applicator capable of delivering 1.0 to 3.0 cc per bearing block

access_required: Physical access to both Z-axis linear rails and the bearing blocks

visual_references.description: End stop assembly diagram (included in packet artifacts; not specifically tied to grease nipple location for this procedure).

steps.title: Visually inspect both Z-axis linear rails for grease wetness or dried grease
steps.purpose: Determine whether lubrication is present (wet grease) or absent (dry/dried grease) to decide whether lubrication is required.
steps.instruction: Visually inspect both Z-axis linear rails and look for wet grease and/or signs of dried grease.
steps.expected_result: You can classify the condition of the Z-axis linear rails as either wet with grease or dry (not wet with grease) / showing dried grease.
steps.healthy_condition: Rails show grease wetness and/or signs of dried grease (indicating grease presence).
steps.failure_condition: Rails are dry (not wet with grease), indicating lubrication is needed.

actions.label: Inspect Z-axis rails
actions.exact_action: Visually inspect both Z-axis linear rails for wetness of grease and/or signs of dried grease.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Visually inspect both Z-axis linear rails for wetness of grease and/or signs of dried grease. If the rails are dry (not wet with grease) then lubricate the bearing blocks using automotive bearing grease (e.g., Mobil1™).

steps.title: If rails are dry, lubricate the bearing blocks using automotive bearing grease
steps.purpose: Restore lubrication to the Z-axis bearing blocks when the rails are dry.
steps.instruction: If the rails are dry (not wet with grease), lubricate the bearing blocks using automotive bearing grease (e.g., Mobil1™).
steps.expected_result: Grease is applied to the bearing blocks via the grease nipples using the specified quantity per block (1.0 to 3.0 cc per block).
steps.healthy_condition: Grease is applied to each bearing block through its grease nipples with 1.0 to 3.0 cc per block.
steps.failure_condition: Grease is not applied to the bearing blocks (or lubrication is attempted by wiping rails instead of greasing the bearing blocks).

actions.label: Lubricate bearing blocks
actions.exact_action: If the rails are dry (not wet with grease) then lubricate the bearing blocks using automotive bearing grease (e.g., Mobil1™).

stop_or_escalate_if: If rails show signs of dried grease but lubrication cannot be performed as specified (e.g., inability to access nipples), stop and escalate to maintenance support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If the rails are dry (not wet with grease) then lubricate the bearing blocks using automotive bearing grease (e.g., Mobil1™).

steps.title: Locate the grease nipples on the two bearing blocks
steps.purpose: Ensure grease is applied to the correct lubrication points (the bearing blocks via the nipples).
steps.instruction: Locate the grease nipples: there are two (2) bearing blocks, each with one standard 1/4-in nipple on each end (four (4) nipples total).
steps.expected_result: You identify four (4) grease nipples total: two bearing blocks, one 1/4-in nipple on each end of each block.
steps.healthy_condition: All four nipples are located and accessible for greasing the bearing blocks.
steps.failure_condition: Nipples cannot be located or accessed, preventing lubrication as specified.

actions.label: Find grease nipples
actions.exact_action: Locate the grease nipples: there are two (2) bearing blocks, each with one standard 1/4-in nipple on each end (four (4) nipples total).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the nipples to apply grease to the bearing blocks, stop and escalate to maintenance support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: There are two (2) bearing blocks with one standard 1/4-in nipple on each end each, so there are four (4) nipples to grease.

steps.title: Apply 1.0 to 3.0 cc of grease to each bearing block
steps.purpose: Apply the specified grease quantity to ensure adequate lubrication of each bearing block.
steps.instruction: Using a grease applicator, add 1.0 to 3.0 cc of grease to each bearing block (via its grease nipples).
steps.expected_result: Total grease applied per bearing block is within 1.0 to 3.0 cc, and grease has been delivered through the bearing block nipples.
steps.healthy_condition: Each bearing block receives 1.0 to 3.0 cc of grease (four nipples total used to deliver grease to the two blocks).
steps.failure_condition: Grease quantity per block is outside 1.0 to 3.0 cc, or grease is not delivered to the bearing blocks through the nipples.

actions.label: Grease bearing blocks
actions.exact_action: Adding 1.0 to 3.0 cc of grease to each block should be adequate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Adding 1.0 to 3.0 cc of grease to each block should be adequate.

steps.title: Do not substitute wiping grease on the rails for lubrication
steps.purpose: Ensure lubrication is performed correctly at the bearing blocks rather than only cosmetically on the rails.
steps.instruction: Do not rely on wiping grease on the rails as a substitute for lubrication.
steps.expected_result: Lubrication is performed by greasing the bearing blocks via the grease nipples (not by wiping rails).
steps.healthy_condition: Grease is applied to bearing blocks through nipples; rail wiping is not used as the lubrication method.
steps.failure_condition: Only wiping grease on the rails is performed without greasing the bearing blocks via nipples.

actions.label: Confirm correct lubrication method
actions.exact_action: Wiping grease on the rails is not adequate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: NOTE: Wiping grease on the rails is not adequate.

success_criteria: Both Z-axis linear rails are inspected and classified as wet/dried or dry.
If rails are dry, grease is applied to each bearing block via the four (4) 1/4-in grease nipples with 1.0 to 3.0 cc per block.
Lubrication is performed via nipples; wiping grease on rails is not used as the lubrication method.
healthy_conditions: Rails show grease wetness and/or signs of dried grease.
After lubrication (when initially dry), grease is applied to each bearing block via the nipples with 1.0 to 3.0 cc per block.
failure_conditions: Rails are dry (not wet with grease) and bearing blocks are not lubricated via nipples.
Lubrication is attempted by wiping rails instead of greasing bearing blocks.
Rails show signs of dried grease but lubrication cannot be performed as specified due to inability to access nipples.
escalation_guidance: If lubrication cannot be performed as specified (e.g., inability to access nipples), stop and escalate to maintenance support.
